name: Fuel gas trailers (CNG or LNG)

hazards.control: Injection line rated and restrained; compressor isolated and blown down before work.

function: Rows of high-pressure or cryogenic gas trailers parked along the pad edge that supply fuel gas to dual-fuel engines and to the generators of an electric fleet where no field gas line exists.

tabs.overview: Trailers are swapped by truck as they empty; a decant or vaporizer skid regulates the gas to the conditioning skid. The simulator draws them for the gas-burning fleets.
tabs.engineering: Trailer count from the fleet gas demand and the swap cycle.
tabs.safety: High-pressure or cryogenic gas; exclusion zone and no ignition sources.
tabs.evidence: Electric fleet article (S37); pad photographs for layout only (S9).
